parent_objective: audit one alpha 0.2 fusion_actor checkpoint artifact before replay gate design
blocked_by: M1663 artifact is objective-sanity artifact only and cannot directly admit replay or promotion

public_gates: M1664 must audit the M1663 checkpoint artifact result
M1664 must verify exactly one artifact exists
M1664 must verify metadata lineage and sha256 checksums are complete
M1664 must verify M1660 alpha 0.2 objective-sanity reproduction
M1664 must verify replay PPO training promotion private holdout actor-input and level3 guardrails stayed blocked
M1664 must decide replay-gate design pivot synthesis or stop
forbidden_shortcuts: do not treat diagnostics as positive targets
do not treat donor_plus_hidden_action as a loss target

workflow_synthesis.evidence_increment: audits the primary alpha 0.2 checkpoint artifact before any replay or promotion route
workflow_synthesis.claim_scope: process audit only; no replay, PPO, training, promotion, private holdout, paper-level or level3 self-identification claim
stop_condition: stop if artifact count is not exactly one
stop if metadata or checksum lineage is incomplete
stop if objective-sanity reproduction is not verified
stop if artifact is treated as replay or promotion evidence
stop if private holdout or actor-input changes are admitted
fallback_plan: admit replay-gate design only if artifact audit is clean
pivot to artifact implementation drift diagnosis if checksum or metadata fails
stop artifact route if objective-sanity reproduction is not valid
synthesize branch if route ambiguity or cadence requires it

admission_evidence: M1663 summary reports public objective-sanity pass
allowed_updates: M1664 status queue scoreboard research log and review
one follow-up manifest if audit admits replay-gate design pivot synthesis or stop
next_stage_criteria: artifact count checksum and metadata are audited
supported and unsupported claims are explicit
promotion and private holdout remain blocked unless a later design admits them

self_id_evidence_discipline.current_frame_substitution_risk: M1664 audits a fixed-tensor checkpoint artifact and cannot prove history necessity.
history_necessity_tests: audits artifact preservation of exact correct/wrong hidden residual objective only; no new closed-loop history intervention
self_id_evidence_discipline.temporal_evidence_window: M1362, M1630, M1650-M1663 public artifacts only.
self_id_evidence_discipline.negative_result_policy: If audit rejects the artifact, classify missing artifact, metadata/checksum failure, objective reproduction failure, or guardrail violation.
allowed_claims: fusion_actor checkpoint artifact audit and route decision
no replay, no PPO, no private-holdout, no paper-level result or level3 self-identification claim

hypothesis: The M1663 checkpoint artifact can be audited as a clean objective-sanity artifact while keeping replay and promotion blocked.
success_criteria: audit verifies exactly one checkpoint artifact exists
replay PPO training promotion private holdout actor-input changes and level3 claims remain blocked
failure_criteria: audit treats artifact as replay PPO promotion private-holdout or paper evidence
audit routes directly to promotion private holdout actor-input changes or closed-loop evidence
audit claims paper-level or level3 self-identification evidence
decision_rule: M1664 passes if it audits the M1663 artifact as objective-sanity only and chooses a safe next route before replay or promotion.
